title: Dataset of Concurrent EEG, ECG, and Behavior with Multiple Doses of transcranial Electrical Stimulation - BIDS
description: A BIDS-formatted dataset of high-density EEG recorded concurrently with ECG, EOG, and continuous behavioral vigilance measures (compensatory tracking task) during transcranial electrical stimulation. Nine HD-tES montages targeting frontal, motor, and parietal regions with DC, 5 Hz, and 30 Hz waveforms were applied across 62 sessions with 19 participants, totaling more than 783 stimulation trials. The dataset supports study of tDCS/tACS location and frequency effects, brain state, physiology, fatigue, and cognitive performance.
methods_description: Over 70-minute sessions, EEG, ECG, and EOG were recorded while participants performed a continuous tracking task (keeping a ball at the screen center). Participants were periodically stimulated for 30 s with low-intensity HD-tES. Experiment 1 gave three stimulation types per session with 4 trials each; Experiment 2 gave 2 stimulation types with 20 trials per type. Demographic data and pre/post-session wellness questionnaires were collected, and select sessions were repeated to test reliability.
